title: I3 Camera status
description: Status of a camera stream, sent by the vision service when a stream stops or comes back (FR-02, NFR-03). Written to the Redis stream atlas:camera-status (System Architecture, I3). The 'alert' state of FR-02 is not sent here: the backend derives it from the events of the camera.

status.description: online: frames are arriving; offline: the stream stopped and the reader is trying to reconnect.

ts.description: UTC time at which the status changed.
